gui.devmod.foundry_guide.title: Foundry Guide
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page1.title: Foundry Basics
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page1.body: Build a hollow foundry using Foundry Bricks, Controller, Drain, and Tanks. The controller must face the interior and the top stays open. Structure size is limited by your foundry tier.
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page2.title: Fuel and Heat
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page2.body: Insert fuel buckets into the controller fuel slot. The foundry must heat up before full efficiency. High thermal stress reduces efficiency and can trigger incidents.
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page3.title: Melting and Alloying
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page3.body: Put meltable items in the four input slots. Recipes define molten output, temperature, time, and byproducts. Alloying happens automatically when the molten tank contains the required fluids.
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page4.title: Casting and Parts
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page4.body: Use a faucet to pour into a casting table or basin. Casts define the shape and may be consumed if the recipe says so. Channels can route molten fluids to multiple casting blocks.
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page5.title: Purity and Quality
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.page5.body: Ore and raw inputs add impurity. Foundry flux raises purity, improving melt quality. The controller shows melt purity and quality, and tools inherit the quality tier.
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.progress.title: Progression
gui.devmod.foundry_guide.progress.body: Track your tier, specialization, and foundry milestones.
gui.devmod.foundry.alloy_hint: Add compatible fluids to form alloys

devmod.slider.weapon.attack_damage.desc: Base damage dealt per hit. Final damage = (Base + Weapon Damage) × Strength × Crit × Enchants. Shown on item tooltip.
devmod.slider.weapon.attack_speed.desc: Attacks per second. Higher = faster swings. Affects DPS directly. Cooldown shown as sword icon filling up.
devmod.slider.weapon.attack_reach.desc: Maximum distance to hit entities. Vanilla sword: 3 blocks. Affects both melee and sweep attacks.
devmod.slider.weapon.knockback.desc: Push force on hit. Knockback enchant adds +1 per level. Sprint attacks add extra knockback.
devmod.slider.weapon.damage_bonus.desc: Flat damage added after all multipliers. Bypasses armor calculations. Useful for guaranteed minimum damage.
devmod.slider.weapon.sweeping_ratio.desc: % of damage dealt to secondary targets in sweep attack. Sweeping Edge enchant increases this. Only affects swords.
devmod.slider.weapon.armor_penetration.d: % of target armor ignored. 50% penetration vs 20 armor = treats as 10 armor. Stacks with armor-piercing enchants.
devmod.slider.weapon.base_damage_bonus.d: Added to weapon base damage before multipliers. Affects all damage calculations including crits.
devmod.slider.weapon.armor_shred.desc: Reduces target armor value per hit. Stacks up to cap. Resets after combat ends.
devmod.slider.weapon.crit_chance.desc: % chance to deal critical hit. Vanilla requires falling + full attack cooldown. This adds passive crit chance.
devmod.slider.weapon.crit_damage.desc: Critical hit damage multiplier. Vanilla crit = 1.5x. This value is the total multiplier (2.0 = double damage).
devmod.slider.weapon.lifesteal.desc: % of damage dealt returned as health. Calculated after all damage reductions. Does not trigger on blocked damage.
devmod.slider.weapon.fire_damage.desc: Additional fire damage per hit. Ignites target. Fire Aspect enchant adds separate fire damage.
devmod.slider.weapon.magic_damage.desc: Additional magic damage per hit. Ignores physical armor. Affected by magic resistance.
devmod.slider.weapon.vs_undead.desc: Bonus damage multiplier vs undead mobs (zombies, skeletons, phantoms, etc). Stacks with Smite enchant.
devmod.slider.weapon.vs_arthropods.desc: Bonus damage multiplier vs arthropod mobs (spiders, silverfish, bees, etc). Stacks with Bane enchant.
devmod.slider.weapon.vs_players.desc: Bonus damage multiplier vs players. For PvP balancing. Does not affect PvE damage.
devmod.slider.weapon.true_damage.desc: Damage that ignores ALL defenses (armor, enchants, resistance effects). Use sparingly for balance.
devmod.slider.armor.physical_reduction.d: Reduces physical damage (melee, falls, projectiles). Max 80%. Formula: Final = Damage × (1 - Reduction%).
devmod.slider.armor.fire_reduction.desc: Reduces fire/lava damage. Stacks with Fire Resistance potion. Max 80%.
devmod.slider.armor.magic_reduction.desc: Reduces magic damage (potions, guardians, evokers). Max 80%.
Reduces explosion damage (creepers, TNT, fireworks). Stacks with Blast Protection. Max 80%.
devmod.slider.armor.projectile_reduction: Reduces arrow/trident damage. Stacks with Projectile Protection. Max 80%.
devmod.slider.armor.armor_bonus.desc: Additional armor points. Each point = 4% damage reduction (diminishing returns). Max effective: 20 points.
devmod.slider.armor.toughness_bonus.desc: Reduces armor penetration from high damage hits. Diamond/Netherite have base toughness. Smooths damage spikes.
devmod.slider.armor.knockback_resistance: % resistance to knockback. Netherite armor has 10% per piece. 100% = immune to knockback.
devmod.slider.armor.thorns_damage.desc: Damage reflected to attackers. Thorns enchant adds 1-4 damage randomly. This is fixed damage per hit taken.
devmod.slider.armor.shield_block_strengt: Damage absorbed by shield before breaking guard. Higher = blocks stronger hits without stagger.
devmod.slider.armor.shield_recovery.desc: Time reduction for shield cooldown after blocking. Faster recovery = more frequent blocking.
devmod.slider.ranged.draw_speed.desc: How fast bow/crossbow charges. 1.0 = vanilla speed. 2.0 = twice as fast. Affects time to full charge.
devmod.slider.ranged.charge_time.desc: Time in ticks to fully charge. Bow: 20 ticks vanilla. Lower = faster shots. Crossbow uses this for reload.
devmod.slider.ranged.accuracy.desc: Arrow spread reduction. 1.0 = vanilla accuracy. Higher = tighter grouping. Affects all ranged weapons.
devmod.slider.ranged.range.desc: Maximum effective range in blocks. Beyond this, arrows despawn or deal reduced damage.
devmod.slider.ranged.projectile_speed.de: Arrow/projectile velocity. Affects travel time and arc. Higher = flatter trajectory, faster hits.
Gravity multiplier for projectiles. 0 = no drop. 1.0 = vanilla. Higher = more arc/drop.
devmod.slider.ranged.projectile_spread.d: Random spread angle in degrees. 0 = perfectly straight. Multishot adds inherent spread.
devmod.slider.ranged.base_damage.desc: Base projectile damage before Power enchant. Full charge bow: 6 damage vanilla. Crit adds +50%.
devmod.slider.ranged.piercing.desc: Number of entities arrow can pierce through. Piercing enchant adds levels. 0 = stops on first hit.
devmod.slider.ranged.multishot_count.des: Number of arrows fired per shot. Multishot enchant = 3. Consumes 1 arrow, fires multiple.
devmod.slider.ranged.crit_chance.desc: % chance for ranged critical hit. Vanilla bow crits require full charge. This adds passive chance.
devmod.slider.ranged.crit_damage.desc: Ranged critical damage multiplier. Vanilla full charge = 1.5x. This is total multiplier.
devmod.slider.ranged.loyalty_speed.desc: How fast trident returns with Loyalty. Higher = faster return. Only works with Loyalty enchant.
devmod.slider.ranged.riptide_distance.de: Distance traveled with Riptide. Higher = further launch. Only works in water/rain with Riptide enchant.
devmod.slider.general.stack_size.desc: Maximum items per inventory slot. Vanilla max is 64. Some items (tools, armor) stack to 1 by default.
devmod.slider.general.durability.desc: Current durability points. 0 = broken. Unbreaking enchant gives chance to not consume durability per use.
devmod.slider.general.repair_cost.desc: XP level cost to repair/rename in anvil. Increases each repair. Max 39 before 'Too Expensive'. Reset by renaming.
devmod.slider.general.unbreakable.desc: When enabled, item never loses durability. Sets minecraft:unbreakable component. Shown in item tooltip.
devmod.slider.armor.thorns_reflect.desc: When enabled, thorns damage is reflected to attackers. Requires thorns damage value > 0.
devmod.slider.armor.shield_reflect.desc: When enabled, blocked damage is partially reflected to attacker. Requires shield block strength > 0.
devmod.slider.ranged.multishot.desc: When enabled, fires multiple projectiles per shot. Number controlled by multishot count slider.
devmod.slider.ranged.infinity.desc: When enabled, bow doesn't consume arrows (requires at least 1 arrow in inventory). Incompatible with Mending.
devmod.slider.ranged.riptide_water.desc: When enabled, Riptide only works in water or rain. Disable to use Riptide anywhere.
devmod.slider.ranged.channeling.desc: When enabled, trident summons lightning on hit during thunderstorms. Requires Channeling enchant normally.
